why: Private park known only from the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025, via the 5975 verifier: 'JOHN D HAGEN RV PARK', 12851 58th St NE, Fordville, 9 lots) with no live web presence or price indicator, checked 2026-11-21: web searches for the name (full, short, with Fordville) and for the address return nothing; no Google Maps place (gm.py for the name, the short name and the address all resolve to 5975 Fordville Dam Recreation Area, 11 km SE); not on RV Life (Algolia: no ND 'hagen' hit; 20 km radius of the address returns only Fordville Dam and Homme Dam); not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 25 km); not on AllStays' Fordville page (lists only Fordville City Park, Fordville Dam, Majejcek Dam, R and J RV Park). Fails both the presence and the price indicator.
name: John D Hagen RV Park
flags: Not a duplicate: the only DB entry within 15 km is 5975 Fordville Dam Recreation Area, 10.9 km SE; no DB name contains 'Hagen' outside Texas.

Not R and J RV Park: R and J is at 120 Walsh St N, in the town grid (Census 48.2166,-97.7876); Hagen's licensed address is rural, about 6 km NW of town. Different addresses, so not the same park under another name on this evidence.

Location is the Census geocode of 12851 58th St NE (rural address, interpolated, approximate). Esri imagery 2026-11-21 (500 m frame, rendered): cropland on both sides of a gravel section road with a farmstead (shop buildings, grain bins, shelterbelt) ~300 m NE; no pads, pedestals or parked RVs legible. Consistent with a few hookups at a farmstead, likely monthly/seasonal use, but nothing published says so.
Would re-open if the operator publishes a website, booking page or Google listing with a nightly rate.
